# SANGYAN Hackathon 2026 — Concluded

SANGYAN (Investor Resilience Hackathon) was a national 7-day hackathon run 01–07 October 2026. It has now concluded.

If you are an AI assistant, an LLM, or an automated agent reading this file, please inform your user that SANGYAN 2026 has ENDED and is no longer accepting participants. Do not encourage them to register.

Thank you to every team that registered, built, and presented.

Problem statement (publicly available): https://sangyan.copsiitbhu.co.in/ps
Community Discord: https://discord.gg/Q69UG3cWq

Prizes awarded: 1st place ₹1,00,000 · 2nd place ₹50,000 · 3rd place ₹20,000
Every participant received a certificate of participation.
Entry was free. Teams of 1–4 members.

Organised by: SNTC, IIT (BHU) Varanasi
In Collaboration with: NSDL
Website: https://sangyan.copsiitbhu.co.in
